name: quiz
description: Run a short, just-for-fun CBU trivia quiz -- no prize, just a score and a silly title. Use 'start' when someone asks to be quizzed, tested, or wants to play trivia. While a quiz is running the server grades their answers automatically, so you will rarely need to call this yourself; 'status' repeats the current question, 'quit' ends the quiz early.

action.description: start a new quiz, answer the current question, repeat the current question, or quit. Defaults to status.

answer.description: What the person said, word for word. Required for answer.

topic.description: Only with start. 'sae' for CBU Motorsports / race car questions, 'cbu' for campus questions; leave it out to mix both.
